scope_note: Email notifications via Resend — password reset and user invite emails dispatched async via BullMQ email.queue
acceptance_criteria: IEmailSenderPort in domain/ports/ with sendPasswordResetEmail(to, resetLink) and sendInviteEmail(to, inviteLink, role)
NotificationService assembles full link from FRONTEND_BASE_URL env var and enqueues job
EmailQueueProducer wraps BullMQ Queue with attempts:3, exponential backoff delay:5000ms
EmailWorkerProcessor routes password-reset and invite jobs to ResendEmailSenderAdapter
Unknown job type throws UnhandledEmailJobTypeError (exhaustiveness guard)
ResendEmailSenderAdapter reads RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_FROM_ADDRESS via ConfigService — fails fast on startup if absent
AuthModule and UserModule import NotificationModule and inject NotificationService into ForgotPasswordUseCase and InviteUserUseCase
Unit tests for NotificationService using FakeEmailQueueProducer (no I/O)
Integration tests mock resend.emails.send and assert correct payload shape
pnpm typecheck, lint, vitest run src/modules/notification, and integration test all exit 0
